_schema: type: consumable|weapon|armor|material|keepsake. price is the single value source; shops buy at shops.json sellRate * price. statMods apply while equipped (slot). effect for consumables. A KEEPSAKE is a story item: no price, noSell, no slot, no effect — so shop.sellable(), menu's equip list and menu's use list each pass over it by the filter they already have, and nothing new had to learn the word. It is carried, named, and never spent.

hand-lamp.name: Grandmother's hand-lamp
hand-lamp.desc: Her lamp, off the hook by the door. He is not pretending it is for the light.

walking-staff.name: Walking Staff
walking-staff.desc: A traveler's staff, more friend than weapon.

boat-hook.name: Boat Hook
boat-hook.desc: Long, hooked, and meaner than it looks on the quay.

oilskin-coat.name: Oilskin Coat
oilskin-coat.desc: Turns rain, spray, and shallow teeth.

timber-jack.name: Timber Jack
timber-jack.desc: Boiled leather over lath — dock-brawl proof.

reed-tuft.name: Reed Tuft
reed-tuft.desc: Soft weaving reed. The Weave pays for these.

sprite-dust.name: Sprite Dust
sprite-dust.desc: Glimmers faintly. Chandlers want it for lamp-wicks.

duskpad-pelt.name: Duskpad Pelt
duskpad-pelt.desc: Dense, dusk-gray fur. Warm and waterproof.

bramble-sap.name: Bramble Sap
bramble-sap.desc: Sticky amber sap. Caulkers boil it into pitch.

cracked-shell.name: Cracked Shell
cracked-shell.desc: Plate off a scree shell. Armorers grind it into jack-lath.

eel-skin.name: Eel Skin
eel-skin.desc: Supple and slick. Good gloves, better wallets.
